open_points.subject: execute_trial_case expected file-output digest comparison
open_points.text: - execute_trial_case: [BEHAVIOR] The outcome is the sandbox outcome of the same name; a succeeded execution is passed when the case has no expected outputs or every output's digest equals the expected one — a value output's digest is content_identity of a BytesContent holding its canonical bytes and a file output's is the hexadecimal SHA-256 of the bytes of its FilePayload content, or of each FileListPayload contents item in list order, the content_digest its FileFacts records, both computed from what the sandbox returned, and an expected output's is read from its stored record; the outcome is decided before any output is written, so no output is read back from the store —, a many file output equal only with the same length and equal digests position by position, and output_mismatch otherwise; a succeeded value output whose canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant makes the outcome contract_violation.
open_points.other_text: - add_trial_case: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] Each input value becomes a StoredValue with the stored schema of its port (M21: the port's value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items) and the class its contract input port declares, each expected output a StoredValue with its port's stored schema and the highest class of the case's inputs from highest_disclosure_class; value_digest is content_identity of a BytesContent holding the bytes, value_id content_identity of the StoredValueContent, and the bytes are stored with put_value_bytes; a port refers to its values by StoredValuesRef entries naming it: one StoredValuesRef for a value port, and for a many file port one StoredValuesRef per file, consecutive in list order; inputs and expected_outputs MUST list these refs in port name order by Unicode code point, so that equal facts give an equal TrialCaseContent.
open_points.question: Must expected file outputs store the hexadecimal SHA-256 of their bytes as value_digest, or must execute_trial_case compare their content_identity(BytesContent) digests instead?
